title: Capture
purpose: Recording a review: choosing and previewing a display, window or Android/Quest device, recording it with the microphone and system audio in sync, the pointer or touches beside it, Record more takes, and finalizing the media into a playable session.

title: Transcription
purpose: Turning a session's audio into a local, timestamped transcript: the speech runtime and its models, speech detection, the vocabulary prompt, word timing that seeking relies on, and retrying a failed transcription.

title: Review workspace
purpose: What the person sees and does in the app: projects and sessions in the sidebar, playback and the scrubber, the transcript and word seeking, the recording dock, settings, the window chrome and the agent handoff.

title: Agent CLI
purpose: The `cue` command an agent runs to find sessions and take evidence from them: transcripts, frames, clips, cursor positions and the moments a reviewer pointed at.
